'''Momota Inoue''' (Japanese: '''井上桃太''') is the {{wp|manga author}} of several [[Pokémon manga]]. She was born on June 19, 1985 in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. In 2006, she received the 58th [[Shogakukan]] Rookie Comic Grand Prize, Children's Division, for her work ''Red Enza''.

==Pokémon manga by Momota Inoue==
* [[Pocket Monsters BW: Meetings with the Legends]] (2010)
* {{ma|Zoroark: Master of Illusions}} (2010)
* {{ma|White—Victini and Zekrom}} (2011)
* {{ma|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice}} (2012)
* {{ma|Genesect and the Legend Awakened}} (2013)
